claim: A floor or ceiling tile is sampled as if each side were rounded DOWN to a power of two: a 64x400 tile on a floor shows only its first 64x256 and the rest is never drawn. Walls are not affected the same way.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/tiles.cpp:281-292 tileUpdatePicSiz stores log2 rounded down; the floor rasteriser masks texture lookups with it (engine.cpp:2951 ceilscan)
use: Put only power-of-two tiles on floors and ceilings; rules_blood 'flat-tile-power-of-two' checks a map.
